description: This file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakeRuntime component, verifying trigger word detection, trimming of voice command text, and gating logic with respect to wake words and timing.

classes.name: VoiceWakeRuntimeTests
classes.description: A struct containing multiple test functions to validate voice wake word detection, trimming, and gate functionalities.

methods.name: `trims after trigger keeps post speech`
methods.description: Tests that the text is correctly trimmed after a trigger word, leaving the post-speech content.

methods.name: `trims after trigger returns original when no trigger`
methods.description: Tests that the text remains unchanged when there is no trigger word.

methods.name: `trims after first matching trigger`
methods.description: Ensures only the first trigger is considered, and subsequent text is retained.

methods.name: `has content after trigger false when only trigger`
methods.description: Verifies that no content is detected after the trigger if only the trigger word is spoken.

methods.name: `has content after trigger true when speech continues`
methods.description: Verifies detection of content following a trigger word.

methods.name: `trims after chinese trigger keeps post speech`
methods.description: Tests trimming for Chinese trigger words, including non-Latin characters.

methods.name: `trims after trigger handles width insensitive forms`
methods.description: Ensures that full-width or stylized trigger words are recognized correctly.

methods.name: `gate requires gap between trigger and command`
methods.description: Checks that the gating logic enforces a minimum gap between trigger and command.

methods.name: `gate accepts gap and extracts command`
methods.description: Verifies that command extraction works when the gap condition is satisfied.

methods.name: `gate command text handles foreign string ranges`
methods.description: Tests command text extraction handling with non-standard string ranges.
